quick_setup.desc: Transform your car infotainment into a blazing-fast smart tablet in one click! A comprehensive upgrade delivering the sleek AeroBar dock alongside official Google Play Services & essential apps for the ultimate connected driving experience.
quick_setup.features_body:
• Enhanced Aero Bar Dock: Core navigation buttons (Back, Home, Recents), super task manager, full apps drawer, floating smart climate control, and screen sleep mode, with stock bar hidden.
• Official Google Services Suite: Google Play Store, Play Services, and essential apps (Chrome, Google Maps, Arabic-enabled Gboard, Files by Google, Google Search, and Speech Services).
• Instant Auto-Launch: Aero Bar starts automatically as soon as the screen completes its initial reboot.
quick_setup.chk_wipe_title: ⚠️ Perform Clean Factory Data Wipe Before Installation (/data partition)
quick_setup.chk_wipe_hint: Optional: Purges old user apps, corrupted caches, and leftover files to start with a fresh clean slate.

Do you want to proceed?

quick_setup.basket_summary: Quick Setup: Aero Bar & Complete Google Services Suite

install_hvac_bar.view_title: 🚀 Install Enhanced Navigation & Climate Bar (Aero Bar)
install_hvac_bar.desc: Replaces the bottom HVAC bar with the enhanced Aero Bar; hardware navigation, advanced task switcher, apps drawer, climate controls, and screen sleep mode.
install_hvac_bar.preview_title: 📸 Live Preview of Aero Bar Dock in Vehicle Screen:
install_hvac_bar.specs_body:
• System Navigation Buttons (Back / Home / Recents): Instant response for smooth navigation and effortless back control inside any app without driver distraction.
• Advanced Recent Apps Task Switcher: Premium cards carousel for rapid switching between active apps and instant memory cleanup.
• Integrated All Apps Drawer: Floating drawer to easily access and launch all installed applications on your vehicle screen.
• Floating Minimal HVAC Controls: Intelligent pop-up temperature and fan sliders that adjust smoothly and auto-dismiss without interrupting your GPS maps.
• Screen Sleep Mode (Standby): Long-pressing the Home button (Long-Press Home) turns off the display and puts it into Sleep / Standby mode for night driving and power saving, waking up instantly with a single tap.
install_hvac_bar.confirm_msg:
USB drive ({letter}) will be prepared with the Aero Bar system package, automated permissions, stock HVAC bar hiding, and system reboot script.

Do you want to proceed?
install_hvac_bar.success_msg:
Aero Bar USB has been prepared successfully on ({letter}).
Insert into vehicle head unit to deploy Aero Bar and reboot automatically.
install_hvac_bar.basket_summary: Install Aero Bar & Replace Stock Climate Bar

restore_hvac_bar.desc: Revert all interface modifications back to the 100% untouched Dongfeng dealership factory original SystemUI package without extra navigation buttons.

• Removes extra navigation buttons and restores original factory bar layout.
• Clears caches and rebuilds Dalvik bytecode automatically for optimal system stability.

install_gms.desc:
Official Google Play Services & system suite tailored for your car screen in one click:
• ⚙️ Core System Suite (7 integrated system packages): GMS Framework, Account Manager, Google Play Services, Play Store, Google Search, Speech & TTS, and Files by Google.
• 📦 Optional User Apps: Option to add up to 3 user apps (Gboard, Chrome, Maps) bringing the total to 7-10 packages.
install_gms.clean_reinstall_notice: 💡 Automated Clean Reinstall: System performs an automated deep cleanup of legacy Google services, accounts, and caches prior to installation to ensure zero conflict and 100% stability.
install_gms.confirm_msg:
Prepare Google Services & Files by Google USB on drive {letter}?

Packages and libraries will be staged in calibrated order for vehicle stability.
install_gms.success_msg:
Google Services USB is ready on drive {letter}! 🔥

Insert the USB into your car screen. Execution runs in automated sequential stages.
⚠️ CRITICAL WARNING: KEEP THE USB DRIVE CONNECTED throughout all system reboots! Do NOT remove the USB while the screen is restarting or black. Removal should only occur after the screen fully boots up, stabilizes, and the launcher/apps appear.

⏱️ Estimated Time: ~2 minutes.
📖 For full details, open User_Guide.html on the drive.
🛡️ System Protection: USB runs safely once to protect against loops.

backup.desc:
Keep a safe snapshot of your car's setup:

• 📁 Personal Backup (1:1 Clone): All apps, data, accounts, Wi-Fi & paired Bluetooth devices.
• 🔥 Community Preset: Save your launcher & style into a preset to share with other Shine owners—without private data or passwords.
• 🔒 Total peace of mind—restore anytime!
backup.hint_personal:
🔒 Personal Private Backup (1:1 Complete Vehicle State):
• Full Snapshot: Preserves all Google accounts, saved Wi-Fi networks, paired Bluetooth devices, apps & settings.
• Disaster Recovery: Intended solely for personal restoration back to this exact vehicle.
backup.hint_community:
🌐 Community Shared Preset (Safe for Distribution):
• Zero-Leakage: Completely scrubs Google accounts, Wi-Fi passwords, and paired Bluetooth devices.
• Captured Elements: Custom Launchers (AGAMA/Nova), app widgets, installed third-party apps & custom settings.
• Safe for Sharing: Other owners can safely restore this preset without wiping or corrupting their own accounts.
backup.personal_side_desc:
• No metadata or naming required.
• Automatically binds to vehicle VIN and hardware identity.

• 🏁 Dealership ready: 100% stock state before warranty visits.
• 🔒 Safe: core car controls (AC, reverse camera, steering keys) are untouched.

roadmap.badge: 🔥 Coming in v2.0 • In active laboratory R&D and field testing
roadmap.view_subtitle: Here at Aero Suite, we never settle for ordinary USB utilities; our dream from day one was to engineer the ultimate, smartest software ecosystem worthy of you and your Dongfeng Shine. We worked relentlessly and cracked complex ECU protections to put this build in your hands — but that was only step one! In our upcoming major release (v2.0), we are leaping to a whole new dimension that will blow you away and banish all frustration. Here is an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at what is cooking:
roadmap.feat1_title: ⚡ No More USB Back-and-Forth: Aero Wireless Sync & Live Remote Shell
roadmap.feat1_desc:
• One-Time Magic Pairing: A single smart setup USB configures Wi-Fi and connects your screen automatically to your hotspot with zero manual typing.
• Instant 1-Click Wireless Control: Push apps to the car in 3 seconds over Wi-Fi, freeze the stock launcher, or trigger a reboot cable-free.
• Interactive Live Shell: A built-in real-time terminal for enthusiasts to run Android commands with millisecond response on your car screen.
roadmap.feat2_badge: Integrated Cloud App Store Tested 100% for Shine
roadmap.feat2_title: ☁️ Stop Searching & Wasting Time: Aero Cloud App Hub
roadmap.feat2_desc:
• Vetted Automotive App Store: A curated cloud repository benchmarked specifically for Dongfeng Shine hardware and screen resolutions.
• Fast 1-Click Cloud Install: No more hunting in forums or risking crashes; every APK is verified for stability and low RAM footprint.
• Smart Ecosystem Updates: Instant notifications and one-tap installation whenever new vetted car apps are released.
roadmap.feat3_badge: Community Sharing & Preset Hub for Shine Owners
roadmap.feat3_title: 🌐 The Power of Community: Aero Community Presets Cloud
roadmap.feat3_desc:
• Instant 1-Click Dashboard Themes: Browse community-crafted launcher layouts, cyber widgets, and tachometer presets, applying them in seconds.
• Share Your Signature Build: Upload and share your custom car setups with the global owner community with your custom credits.
• End-to-End Privacy: Bank-grade encryption ensures only layout aesthetics are shared — zero personal data or account tokens ever leave your screen.
roadmap.feat4_title: 🩺 Screen Running Sluggish? IVI Smart Health & Diagnostics
roadmap.feat4_desc:
• Real-Time IVI Telemetry: Diagnose RAM consumption, internal storage, CPU loads, and thermals in seconds with clear visual graphs.
• 1-Click Performance Boost: Detect hidden rogue background services and purge cached memory with one tap to eliminate lag and stutter.
• Proactive Health Insights: Plain-English vehicle infotainment health reports helping you keep your screen running as fast as day one.
